caption: The drawing features a single object positioned roughly at the center of a plain, beige or off-white background. The object is an outline drawing of a short-sleeved dress with a fitted bodice, round neckline, and a gathered, flared skirt that reaches roughly knee-length. The bodice includes vertical seam lines, and the skirt is depicted with two layers, marked by a horizontal seam about one-third from the bottom edge; both layers are indicated by simple, curved dashed lines. The dress has short, slightly puffed sleeves with horizontal seam lines at the cuffs. The outline is rendered in thin, black ink lines without any shading, color fill, or additional decoration. The rest of the page is empty, with only a few small, scattered brownish spots, possibly due to paper aging.
title: Child's Dress
